One district one product: Uttar Pradesh pushes artisan goods onto global markets
stories.summary: Launched in 2018, Uttar Pradesh's One District One Product (ODOP) initiative redefines the narrative of craftsmanship by celebrating the uniqueness of traditional arts and crafts. By facilitating artisans with resources, promotional support, and expanded market reach, the program not only nurtures micro-enterprises but also strengthens the rural economy.

stories.title: Scientists found a 2,600-year-old brain inside an Iron Age skull and it was still intact
Tokyo physicists solve a 25-year-old nanotechnology mystery by creating atomically precise 1-nanometre tubes
From Sundar Pichai to Vinod Khosla: Meet the 26 Indian-origin leaders in America's most successful immigrants list
'To stake claim as real TMC': Rebel MPs to meet Lok Sabha Speaker on Monday
Dubai visa rules 2026: 10 major UAE visa changes expats, workers and tourists need to know
stories.summary: The UAE is significantly overhauling its visa and residency rules, introducing expanded Golden Visa benefits, a new Blue Visa for environmental leaders, and specialized permits for emerging industries. These reforms aim to attract global talent and simplify travel, with a proposed GCC Grand Tours visa potentially revolutionizing regional tourism.

stories.title: 11 mysterious dots on a 2,700-year-old figurine are forcing archaeologists to rethink early writing in Guatemala
UK to offer free Meningitis B vaccine to 1 million young people after deadly outbreaks
stories.summary: A major NHS programme will offer the meningitis B vaccine to around one million young people across the UK, including Year 13 students and those under 25 starting university. This initiative aims to protect vulnerable individuals entering environments where the disease spreads easily, following recent life-claiming outbreaks.

stories.title: ‘Suspected of espionage’: China confirms arrest of US citizen
Lorry crashes into railway bridge in Warwickshire, disrupts key UK rail route; driver arrested
US diplomat summoned again: MEA lodges protest against attacks on ships in Hormuz with Indians on board
'Can't protect sons of Mother India': Rahul Gandhi attacks 'compromised' PM Modi for silence on killing of Indian sailors by US Navy
Quote of the day by Warren Buffett: “Time is the friend of the wonderful company, the enemy of…”
EasyJet flight took off from wrong runway point at Manchester Airport after cockpit error
stories.summary: An EasyJet flight from Manchester to Kos mistakenly took off from the wrong runway position, significantly reducing available runway length. While the Airbus A320 departed safely, investigators highlighted the serious safety implications of such navigation errors, especially under different conditions. The AAIB's findings emphasize the potential risks associated with reduced runway distance during take-off.

stories.title: Jaspal Rana passes away at 49: PM Modi, Rahul Gandhi lead nation in mourning
'Traitors need to resign, fight on BJP ticket': Mahua Moitra's challenge to 19 rebel TMC MPs
'We will bring back the Tatas in Bengal': Suvendu Adhikari vows industrial revival, targets Left and TMC
stories.summary: West Bengal's Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has taken a bold stand for industry revival, bringing Tata Group back into the fold. He has openly addressed the failures of previous administrations, including the Left and TMC, and proposed an innovative framework that prioritizes local voices and respects agricultural land.

stories.title: Sole survivor of Air India crash 'struggles with difficult memories' a year after tragedy
stories.summary: One year after surviving the devastating crash of London-bound Flight 171, lone survivor Viswashkumar Ramesh reveals his ongoing struggles with sleep, anxiety, and difficult memories. Despite outward survival, Ramesh faces immense physical, psychological, and financial challenges as he attempts to rebuild his life and support his family. Legal and rehabilitation support are being pursued.

stories.title: The Bronze Age ended with a network failure: The hidden story behind the 1177 BC collapse
More than a headline: Friend remembers Kerala expat killed in Sharjah over TikTok row
'Exam window extended to 195 mins': NTA rolls out 'student-friendly' measures for NEET UG 2026
stories.summary: NEET (UG)-2026 will feature a longer exam window, now 195 minutes, from 2:00 PM to 5:15 PM. Candidates will receive four rough-work pages, with two placed at the booklet's beginning for easier access, addressing feedback on convenience and accessibility. These changes aim for a fairer, more comfortable exam experience.

stories.title: 'Election Commission only remedy': SC dismisses Congress's Meenakshi Natarajan's plea against rejection of Rajya Sabha nomination
'Only legal notice issued': Congress' Meenkashi Natarajan defends Rajya Sabha nomination, claims Form 26 entry was 'not applicable'
stories.summary: Congress Rajya Sabha candidate Meenakshi Natarajan defended her nomination papers, stating a legal notice is not a pending criminal case. She asserted that all relevant details were provided to the Election Commission. The Supreme Court is hearing her plea regarding the disclosure requirements in Form 26.

stories.title: 'They do it when it suits them': Jaishankar on US tariffs and shifting stance on Russian oil
stories.summary: Jaishankar criticized Western nations' double standards on sanctions, particularly regarding India's purchase of Russian oil. He highlighted that the US itself encouraged India to buy Russian crude to stabilize global markets, emphasizing India's decisions are driven by affordability and availability, not geopolitics. Jaishankar pointed out the inconsistent application of sanctions, urging a pragmatic approach.

stories.title: Amarnath Yatra: Shah chairs meeting to review security preparedness
stories.summary: As the Amarnath Yatra approaches its kickoff date of July 3, Union Home Minister Amit Shah gathered key figures, such as the Army Chief and NSA, to strategize on a fortified security framework.

stories.title: In 1812, a powerful earthquake made the Mississippi River flow backwards and created a lake that still exists today
CJP's exam manifesto: 5 points party proposed at Pune protest if a paper gets leaked
stories.summary: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) is protesting nationwide, demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over exam irregularities. They unveiled a five-point manifesto seeking compensation for affected students, swift backup exams, physical answer sheet evaluation, automatic age relaxation, and tech audits. The CJP plans a Delhi protest on June 20 if demands aren't met.

stories.title: 'Netanyahu was not warned in advance': Israeli PM blindsided as Donald Trump scrapped Iran strike plans
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump surprised Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu by cancelling planned strikes against Iran and announcing a potential diplomatic deal within days. Trump claimed Iran's leadership approved a draft framework, aiming to extend a ceasefire and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Netanyahu, reportedly caught off guard, had urged continued military pressure, highlighting growing differences over Iran policy.

stories.title: 'Pristine forests at risk': Jairam Ramesh urges Rajnath Singh to rethink Great Nicobar airport, expand INS Baaz instead
Japan's struggling flagship H3 rocket returns to flight with the debut of a low-cost variant
stories.summary: Japan's H3 rocket achieved a crucial success Friday, launching a new low-cost variant from Tanegashima Space Center. This marks a vital comeback after previous mission failures, bolstering Japan's competitive edge in the global space industry.

stories.title: Has Donald Trump ruled out a strike on Iran's Kharg Island?
PM Modi celebrates '12 years of Nari Shakti', highlights NDA's push for women-led development
stories.summary: In an 'X' post, PM Modi stated that it reflected the prominent role being played by women across education, healthcare, sanitation, housing, sports, science and governance. He further stressed that the efforts being made to ensure women's empowerment are deeply rooted and have helped create an environment where women can realise their full potential and contribute even more strongly to nation-building.

stories.title: Cancer drug shortages prompt NPPA to raise prices of key medicines, vaccines
stories.summary: Cancer patients may face higher costs as the NPPA greenlit a 50% price hike for essential Carboplatin and Cisplatin injections due to rising raw material expenses. This move aims to prevent shortages of these life-saving drugs. Prices for anti-tetanus immunoglobulin and key childhood vaccines were also adjusted to ensure availability.

stories.title: 'Europeans sell weapons used to attack India': Jaishankar clears India's stance on Russian oil
stories.summary: External affairs minister S Jaishankar pushed back against European criticism of India's Russia policy, highlighting that European weapons have been used against India for years. He defended India's energy choices, revealing the US encouraged New Delhi to buy Russian oil in 2022 to stabilize global markets.

stories.title: Kerala colleges face heat over MBBS fee collection despite NMC order
Yusuf Pathan to Saayoni Ghosh: Full list of 19 rebel TMC MPs seeking to split Mamata's party
South Korea court sentences ex-President Yoon to 30 years in jail over 2024 drone case
Thailand's Princess Bajrakitiyabha dies at 47 after over three years in coma; royal succession in focus
"If the surgery goes wrong....": Clavicular’s extreme $35,000 jaw surgery plan sparks explosive internet debate over beauty obsession
stories.summary: Streamer Clavicular sparked major online debate after revealing plans for a $35,000 bimaxillary osteotomy, also known as jaw surgery. In a viral interview, he described the painful recovery, cosmetic goals and criticism surrounding the procedure. Social media users were divided, with some praising his honesty while others criticized growing beauty pressures online. The controversy also reignited conversations about appearance culture, influencer fame and the extreme lengths people take for transformation.

stories.title: Who is Bricks & Minifigs CEO? Ammon McNeff faces tough Coffeezilla questions over missing LEGO Star Wars collection
stories.summary: Coffeezilla’s latest investigation into the Bricks & Minifigs controversy included a direct conversation with CEO Ammon McNeff about a missing LEGO Star Wars collection linked to the Salem, Oregon, store. McNeff said corporate did not know about a spreadsheet tracking the collection. Coffeezilla also revealed documents estimating the collection’s value at roughly $107,000 instead of $200,000.

stories.title: “Free him”: Twitch streamer BruceDropEmOff backs Karmelo Anthony and sparks fierce debate over Austin Metcalf murder conviction
stories.summary: Streamer and YouTuber BruceDropEmOff publicly supported Karmelo Anthony after the teenager was convicted of murdering Austin Metcalf and sentenced to 35 years in prison. Bruce’s “#FREEHIM” message sparked debate online. Supporters viewed it as standing with Anthony, while critics argued it ignored the jury’s decision. The case continues to fuel discussions about race, justice, accountability, and self-defense.

stories.title: Historic 100% attendance at Niti meet, DKS breaks Karnataka boycott
stories.summary: From Congress-governed Kerala, Kartanakta, Himachal Pradesh and Telangana to AAP-governed Punjab, CMs cutting across party lines were present at the meeting where NDA had its strongest ever presence. The participation of Karnataka’s new CM D K Shivakumar marked a significant shift in the state’s approach, ending a boycott by the previous Congress administration.

stories.title: Entire NE, barring one or two states, may be out of AFSPA by next year: Shah
stories.summary: Speaking at the signing of a tripartite memorandum of understanding (MoU) among the Centre, govt of Assam and govt of Nagaland for oil and mineral exploration along the Assam-Nagaland border, Shah said that in PM Narendra Modi’s efforts to establish lasting peace and push development in the north-east, a dozen peace pacts had been signed since 2019, with violent incidents down 80% and the total area under AFSPA shrinking by 80%.

stories.title: Adopt ‘targeted’ delimitation for 170 Lok Sabha seats: Economic Advisory Council to PM Modi
stories.summary: According to the model proposed, Kerala and Tamil Nadu will account for 22 of the 59 proposed two-way splits. In cases of three-way splits, the lion’s share will be in UP (17), followed by Maharashtra (12), Bihar (10), and Bengal (10). As a result, the number of seats in southern states is expected to rise — in Telangana from 17 to 26, Andhra from 25 to 38, Karnataka from 28 to 42, TN from 39 to 59, and Kerala from 20 to 30.

stories.title: TMC crisis deepens as third MP resigns from Rajya Sabha & party
stories.summary: The letter, which has been submitted by Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar in her capacity as “chief whip”, has given Bengal assembly Speaker’s recognition of Ritabrata Banerjee-led TMC rebels, who are also over two-third of the party MLAs, as an example, sources confirmed on a day when the party suffered another setback as its RS member Prakash Chik Baraik resigned from it and the Upper House, making him the third to do so since Monday.

stories.title: SC to hear Natarajan’s plea against rejection of Rajya Sabha candidature today
stories.summary: Senior advocate AM Singhvi sought urgent hearing and stay of declaration of results at least for 24 hours, saying this would facilitate effective hearing before the court to adjudicate validity of the returning officer’s decision to reject Natarajan’s candidature. The plea for urgent mentioning was opposed by senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi who said the only option open for Natarajan is to file an election petition after the declaration of results on Thursday.

stories.title: Compassionate job & financial benefit can’t have conflicting clauses: SC
ED to appeal HC order quashing NewsClick case
stories.summary: ​​Sources in ED said that this goes against their understanding that when an investigation is under way in a PMLA case, a court cannot quash a related predicate offence till the probe is concluded. They also said that the HC judge has either completely overlooked or not fully addressed ED’s crucial contentions despite having kept the judgment reserved for five months. At the stage of determining the merit of the FIR, the court just needed to verify if the allegations made in the complaint, if prima facie true, constitute an offence.

stories.title: Fraudsters creating deepfakes to bypass facial authentication: I4C
stories.summary: Sharing this latest modus operandi in a public advisory on Wednesday, Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C) said scammers were using facial recordings obtained through deceptive video calls, fake online job interviews or social engineering tactics to generate a realistic digital replica capable of imitating facial movements, expressions, blinking pattern and voice.

stories.title: Staff dismissal only for grave violations like corruption: SC
stories.summary: A bench of Justices Sanjay Karol and N K Singh said it was not making light of the importance of discipline at the workplace, but in the absence of “corruption, illegal gratification, moral turpitude, misappropriation of funds, proved losses to employer, public scandal or conduct bringing the organisation to disrepute”, an employee could not be visited with the extreme penalty of dismissal.

stories.title: 'Homemakers are nation builders': For payout, SC pegs housewife ‘income’ at Rs 30,000 a month
stories.summary: A Supreme Court bench of Justices Sanjay Karol and N K Singh said women were largely responsible for the preparation of human capital on which the dreams of being the world’s largest economy, among other things, rested. The bench said if the compensation was not paid within three months, the interest rate would increase to 9%, and six months later, it would go up to 12% per annum. It also listed 123 accident compensation claim cases, which were dealt with by a bench led by Justice Karol.

stories.title: NMC flipflops, puts onus of patient appeals on health ministry
stories.summary: When the ministry was asked to intervene on behalf of patients to allow appeals before NMC, the ministry stated the commission was the apex statutory body constituted under the 2019 Act to regulate medical education and the profession. “All matters relating to framing, amendment, and implementation of medical education regulations fall within the domain of NMC,” it said.

stories.title: Teen who flagged CBSE flaws lands full-time job at IIT-Kanpur
stories.summary: Earlier this year, as the board rolled out on-screen marking (OSM) system— under which examiners grade scanned answer sheets online — Adhikary began probing the publicly accessible parts of the set-up. He says he found serious loopholes: a master password sitting in plain sight in the portal’s code, an OTP check that ran on the user’s own browser and a flaw that let one user retrieve another’s records.

stories.title: Unopposed Rajya Sabha wins in MP, Karnataka, Rajasthan
stories.summary: In Karnataka, AICC president Mallikarjun Kharge, Congress nominees Mansoor Ali Khan, educationist and son of former Union minister K Rahman Khan, and party media and publicity department chairperson Pawan Khera, and BJP's M Nagaraja were declared elected unopposed after scrutiny knocked out an independent candidate. Rajasthan’s biennial election also turned into a walkover.

stories.title: 67% of road fatalities in 2024 were pedestrians and two-wheeler riders, ministry report
Lewis Hamilton’s bold new Barcelona paddock look steals attention while Kim Kardashian exits Europe
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton drew attention ahead of the Spanish Grand Prix by debuting a new hairstyle in Barcelona. The Ferrari star appeared relaxed and confident after a strong Monaco weekend. His appearance also came shortly after he publicly thanked Kim Kardashian for her support, while reports continue to suggest the couple’s relationship is becoming increasingly serious.

stories.title: 3 Indians confirmed killed in US strike on tanker off Oman; 3rd vessel attacked
stories.summary: MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said two of the three vessels that came under attack were subject to sanctions administered by the US treasury's office of foreign assets control, while the Settebello had been classified as non-compliant. OFAC acts against vessels involved in violating US sanctions on the sale of Iranian and Russian oil.

stories.title: Navy removes unexploded warhead from struck ship
stories.summary: The Navy responded when the Marshall Islands-flagged MT Olympic Life reported an explosion on its port side aft at 09.45 UTC (3.15pm IST) on May 26 while sailing around 60 nautical miles east of Oman, as per UK Maritime Trade Operations data. It is still not known who fired the missile.

stories.title: Canadian traveller faces $147,000 medical bill after insurance claim is denied: 'I don’t remember anything'
Johnny Somali cites bipolar disorder in bid to reduce prison sentence in South Korea
stories.summary: Controversial streamer Johnny Somali is appealing his six-month sentence in South Korea, citing inability to access bipolar medication. While his lawyer argues for leniency, acknowledging some offenses and victim wishes, prosecutors are pushing for a severe three-year term, citing financial motives and lack of compensation. A decision is due soon.

stories.title: US diplomat found dead in Myanmar hotel, Thai woman detained: 'Out of respect...'
YouTuber Ben Phillips reports gunpoint robbery as French police arrest five suspects
stories.summary: YouTuber Ben Phillips narrowly escaped a terrifying ordeal in Cannes, France, when armed robbers stormed his luxury villa. The intruders, who allegedly demanded money and a safe, stole valuables worth approximately £1.4 million. Phillips recounted how a gun jammed when pointed at him, allowing his escape. French authorities have since arrested five suspects in connection with the brazen heist.

stories.title: Iowa Guv issues statement amid job fear: 'At no point during our negotiations was it even considered to employ H-1B visa holders'
Political philosopher quote of the day: 'Since love and fear can hardly exist together...' — Niccolò Machiavelli
stories.summary: Machiavelli's renowned adage about being 'feared rather than loved,' from his 16th-century work The Prince, endures as a pivotal notion in today’s political dialogue. He posited that while fear can maintain order, it must be balanced with caution to avoid transformation into hatred.

stories.title: DOJ charges three with smuggling migrant kids to US: 'This was a business'
PM Modi meets CMs of various states on sidelines of NITI Aayog governing council meet: Key points discussed
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi convened with chief ministers from Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, and Jammu and Kashmir on the sidelines of the Niti Aayog meet. Discussions covered state affairs and development, with leaders extending congratulations on his 12 years in office. Gifts were exchanged, and key state issues were discussed.

stories.title: Amit Shah announces potential AFSPA rollback next year; groundbreaking MoU paves way for energy self-reliance
stories.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah announced that most of the Northeast may be free from the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act by next year, citing an 80% reduction in violent incidents and AFSPA-covered areas. This progress coincides with a historic oil and mineral exploration pact between Assam and Nagaland, boosting regional development and energy self-reliance.

stories.title: IShowSpeed’s Champions song takes another step toward FIFA World Cup 2026 spotlight with Achraf Hakimi’s TikTok
stories.summary: Achraf Hakimi recently used IShowSpeed’s 2026 World Cup song “Champions” in a TikTok post, according to screenshots shared by IShowSpeedHQ. The update also highlighted a previous photo of Hakimi and Speed together at a stadium. The interaction has increased visibility for the song and added to growing interest surrounding the 2026 FIFA World Cup and its culture.

stories.title: Trump is 'frustrated with everyone' in the White House, says MAGA source: 'Knives are out'
Indian-origin Vijay Kumar pleads not guilty to murders of wife and 3 relatives: 'It's a tragic case of self defense'
Situation Room with a view: Trump, Epstein and Washington’s 'wag the dog' whispers
stories.summary: A new book reveals a White House meeting in July 2025 where officials debated the political fallout from the Jeffrey Epstein files. Vice President JD Vance reportedly urged transparency, warning the issue wouldn't fade. Discussions even touched on releasing documents with allegations about Trump's alleged fixation with nipples, a proposal Vance believed Trump could overcome.

stories.title: Kejriwal questions PM's message to Trump, says India must safeguard national interest
stories.summary: In a pointed critique, Aam Aadmi Party chief Arvind Kejriwal challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi's public expressions of gratitude toward US President Donald Trump. Kejriwal argued that India must safeguard its sovereignty and national interests above all else, referencing recent attacks on Indian vessels and the tragic loss of Indian lives.

stories.title: Pakistani asylum seeker jailed for 10 years for raping 'particularly vulnerable' woman in UK
March to dominance: How victory in states is consolidating BJP in Parliament
stories.summary: The BJP, once a two-seat party, now dominates Indian politics, transforming Atal Bihari Vajpayee's prophecy into reality. Recent state victories, particularly in West Bengal, are strategically bolstering its parliamentary numbers. This focus on consolidation aims to achieve long-term legislative goals like 'One Nation, One Election' and the Uniform Civil Code.

stories.title: New York police officer gets probation for having sex with woman he arrested; avoids prison
Pregnant Sri Lankan care worker fears separation from family as Home Office letters target dependents
Children of Qatari mothers, Qatar-born expats can join national service: Requirements, how to apply
'Don't worry, Indians will survive': Opendoor CEO Kaz Nejatian slammed after he says Indians he fired are 'excellent people'
UAE students can retake exams remotely in certain cases, ministry clarifies
Kerala on alert after suspected Nipah infection detected in Kozhikode, confirms health minister
stories.summary: In Kozhikode, health officials have confirmed a positive test for the Nipah virus in a patient currently requiring ventilator assistance due to severe fever. Authorities are actively tracing potential contacts, having identified 77 people, including healthcare staff and close family, who are under watch.

stories.title: Nations may agree to new target of electricity meeting 35% of global energy demand by 2035
stories.summary: Countries in climate change dialogues may agree to a new global target of electricity meeting 35% of world's energy demand by 2035. Proposed by COP31 Presidency of Türkiye, the '35x35' goal aims to accelerate the shift from fossil fuels to clean electricity, supporting the Paris Agreement and limiting global warming.

stories.title: 'Total control of their oil and gas markets': Much like Venezuela, Trump sets sights on Iran's Kharg Island
stories.summary: Former President Donald Trump issued fresh threats of military strikes against Iran, vowing to hit the country "very hard tonight" and seize control of its oil and gas facilities. The US carried out strikes targeting Iranian surveillance and air defense systems, with Trump warning of intensified bombing if Tehran did not accept American terms.

stories.title: 'AI is now, quantum is next': Vaishnaw opens quantum, AI labs at MNIT Jaipur
stories.summary: India is prioritizing quantum technology over AI for its next major tech advancement, with a new Advanced Quantum Computing and Quantum Communications Lab established at MNIT Jaipur. The lab will focus on Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and post-quantum cryptography, crucial for national security.

stories.title: UK defence secretary John Healey quits after clash with Starmer over military funding
African proverb of the day: 'Only a fool tests the depth of a river with two feet'
From Queen Elizabeth's astrologer to Norway's clairvoyant princess: Royals drawn to the supernatural
Belfast knife attack: 'Hero' who stopped alleged knifeman says £30,000 fundraiser should go to victim
'Kalyan has stood by Didi': TMC's Kirti Azad says Mamata will restore party harmony
stories.summary: Amid escalating tensions within the Trinamool Congress, MP Kirti Azad stepped forward to support Kalyan Banerjee, emphasizing his unwavering loyalty to the party. However, Kalyan has raised the stakes by calling on Mamata Banerjee to make a critical choice between him and her nephew Abhishek.

stories.title: Indian-origin investor Vivek Wadhwa gets trolled for 'teach in rural Alaska' suggestion, says anti-India attacks are getting completely out of control
BJP's Tarun Chugh elected unopposed to Rajya Sabha from Madhya Pradesh
Two Utah women arrested for helping immigrants evade ICE arrest and transporting them away
'Hits Constitution's basic structure': TMC attacks Speaker's recognition of Ritabrata as LoP
stories.summary: The Trinamool Congress is contesting the West Bengal Assembly Speaker's appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as the Leader of the Opposition, citing a breach of the Constitution's foundational tenets. They assert that only their leader, Mamata Banerjee, holds the power to make such nominations.

stories.title: Quote of the day by Margaret Thatcher: "Any woman who understands the problems of running a home will be nearer to understanding the problems of..."
Zohran Mamdani wanted to meet Colombian president Gustavo Petro who posted 'Heil Hitler' on X. Trump said 'No'
Etihad launches new summer routes across Europe and Africa, unveils limited-edition travel kit
Sharjah TikTok feud murder: Indian expat's body to reach Kerala's Kannur today
'India top priority': French diplomatic sources reveal key agenda for G7 summit; US-Iran war, free navigation on list
stories.summary: India is set to collaborate with key players including the US, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and UAE at the upcoming G7 summit, where the focus will be on stabilizing West Asia and its implications for global trading dynamics.

stories.title: ‘Human shield’ on India border: Bangladesh opposition to launch protest over alleged 'push-ins'
stories.summary: Bangladesh's Jamaat-e-Islami and opposition parties are protesting alleged Indian "push-ins" and border killings. They claim thousands were pushed back and 19 Bangladeshis killed by Indian forces. Opposition leaders demand stronger border security and criticize India's stance, emphasizing the impact on Bangladeshi lives and sovereignty.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Kalyan Banerjee sends blunt message to Mamata; Indian sailors killed after US strike on oil tanker off Oman & more
stories.summary: In a tragic incident near the Strait of Hormuz, we have confirmed the deaths of three Indian sailors aboard the MT Settebello after a US military strike. On a different front, CEO of Palantir has urged caution against glorifying the AI-driven job reductions. In Manipur, the discovery of six deceased kidnapped Nagas has intensified ethnic strife in the region.

stories.title: 'Inappropriate to abandon a ship in troubled waters': Babul Supriyo on leaving TMC
stories.summary: TMC leaders Babul Supriyo and Shatrughan Sinha have reaffirmed their loyalty to Mamata Banerjee amidst a party exodus. Both stated they would not abandon the party during its troubled times, emphasizing Banerjee's past support for them. This comes as the TMC faces a significant crisis following electoral defeat and a rebellion weakening its legislative strength.

stories.title: World’s largest ‘whale graveyard’ found beneath the Indian Ocean: A hidden 5-million-year mystery revealed
PM SVANidhi Yojana: How UP became India's top state for street vendor loans
'Cricket helped me catch her': Indian-origin man saves 3-year-old girl falling from London window ledge
Hospital bills, captive patients: Why CCI’s ruling may weaken consumer protection
stories.summary: The Competition Commission of India has cleared twelve Delhi hospitals of overcharging patients. The CCI ruled that regulating healthcare prices is the government's responsibility, not the commission's. This decision comes after a decade-long investigation into allegations of inflated charges for medicines, consumables, and diagnostics. The ruling has sparked debate about consumer protection in India's vast healthcare sector.

stories.title: Mexican mother performed C-section on herself with a kitchen knife after 12 hours of labour, and both she and her baby survived
'All soldiers of Congress party': Sachin Pilot plays down Ashok Gehlot's remarks, says he has always shown affection
stories.summary: Sachin Pilot downplayed Ashok Gehlot's recent criticism, emphasizing party unity and affection. Pilot highlighted national challenges like exam paper leaks and rising prices, vowing to strengthen the INDIA bloc against the BJP. He also criticized the Rajasthan government and alleged institutional pressure on the Election Commission.

stories.title: 'US navy involved, attacks must end': MEA protests repeated strikes on ships with Indians in Hormuz
Surakshit Uttar Pradesh: Dr Vikram Singh on Uttar Pradesh’s security transformation
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh is on a transformative journey, demonstrating an unwavering stance against crime that has catalyzed economic prosperity and investor trust, welcoming investments exceeding Rs 34 lakh crore. The state's aggressive initiatives, including Operation Conviction, have slashed major crime rates like robbery and dacoity, which has resulted in over 1.2 lakh successful convictions.

stories.title: ‘Totally baseless’: Congress rejects Mamata merger; accuses BJP of 'seat-chori' over TMC exodus
'With whose permission captain took ship forward': Family of Indian sailor killed in US strike on ship demands probe
stories.summary: The family of Aditya Sharma, a deck cadet killed in the attack on MT Settebello near the Strait of Hormuz, has demanded an inquiry into the incident. Sharma was among three Indian seafarers who died when the vessel was attacked in the Gulf of Oman.

stories.title: 'Posed as hotel staff': Tunisian man arrested after two British teens sexually assaulted in Valencia bathroom
'Will not leave Mamata in difficult time': Shatrughan Sinha rubbishes speculation of quitting TMC
stories.summary: Amidst a party exodus, TMC MP Shatrughan Sinha pledged loyalty to Mamata Banerjee, stating he wouldn't abandon her during challenging times, recalling her support for him. This declaration follows reports of his alleged involvement in forming a separate faction. Earlier, Sinha also congratulated Prime Minister Narendra Modi on his 12 years in office, calling him a "friend and guide."

stories.title: Cash stack at West Bengal school: Police recover Rs 1.77 crore from locked room
stories.summary: West Bengal Police unearthed nearly Rs 1.77 crore in cash from a private school's locked room in Kanchrapara. The institution's accountant has been detained for questioning, failing to provide a satisfactory explanation for the large sum. Allegations of financial irregularities and cheating have been filed against four individuals, including the school's chairman.

stories.title: 'Choose Abhishek or me': Kalyan Banerjee's blunt message to Mamata amid turmoil in TMC
stories.summary: Trinamool Congress MP Kalyan Banerjee issued an ultimatum to Mamata Banerjee, demanding she choose between her nephew Abhishek Banerjee and senior party workers. Banerjee also announced he would no longer represent Abhishek in legal matters, citing disrespect and arrogance from the latter. This comes amid internal party tensions following electoral setbacks.

stories.title: 'Homemaker builds nation': Supreme Court values domestic care loss at Rs 30,000 every month
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has recognized homemakers as 'nation builders' and ruled that the loss of their domestic care services should be a separate head of compensation in motor accident claims. The court fixed a notional monthly income of Rs 30,000 for assessing this loss, emphasizing the substantial economic and social value of their contributions to families and society.

stories.title: Best places in Spain to watch the August 2026 total solar eclipse: From Galicia to Mallorca

Nobody can dictate to us and nobody would even try to do that... We will always stand true to commitments given to our partners, especially partners like India," he further said.

stories.title: AI reshaping exercise of judicial and sovereign powers: CJI
stories.summary: In a recent address, Chief Justice Surya Kant urged the formation of an international legal framework to manage the transnational implications of AI technology. He warned that AI disrupts traditional notions of jurisdiction and accountability, giving rise to a troubling accountability deficit, particularly for self-governing systems.

stories.title: Two decades later, daughter seeks DNA test of man in quest of paternity
'If they are arrested': Sonam Wangchuk warns of six-week fast ahead of CJP protest
stories.summary: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk will begin a 42-day hunger strike if members of the Cockroach Janta Party are arrested ahead of their Jantar Mantar protest. Wangchuk, traveling from Ladakh, urged supporters to maintain a peaceful demonstration, warning against provocations that could tarnish the youth-led movement. The protest seeks the education minister's resignation over examination irregularities.

stories.title: Some in Delhi keep off census due to misplaced fears of data use
'J&K was, is and will remain part of India': New Delhi rebukes Pakistan at UN
stories.summary: At the UNGA, India took a bold stand against Pakistan, critiquing its manipulation of UN discussions for political leverage. The Indian envoy reaffirmed that Jammu and Kashmir is a core component of India, calling out Pakistan's attempts to distort facts as flimsy and ineffective.

stories.title: CBSE extends post-result application deadline after students flag portal issues
stories.summary: CBSE has extended the deadline for Class 12 answer sheet verification and re-evaluation applications to June 7 due to portal access issues. This decision offers students more time to address concerns about scanned copies and evaluation discrepancies. The board previously opened its portal for students to report issues like missing pages or incorrect answer sheets.

stories.title: Fact check: Did Tyla really get N3on kicked out of a Celebrity Dinner in Monaco? What really happened during the livestream
stories.summary: A viral social media rumor falsely claimed singer Tyla got streamer N3on removed from a celebrity dinner in Monaco after he filmed her during a livestream. The controversy exploded after several X accounts misidentified an Instagram model as the Grammy-winning artist. Posts alleged security threats and a heated confrontation, but fans later pointed out the woman in the video was not Tyla. The incident quickly became another example of how misinformation spreads online when viral clips and celebrity culture collide.

stories.title: “You and your fake husband....": Candace Owens accuses Laura Loomer of lying about her marriage in explosive social media feud
stories.summary: Laura Loomer and Candace Owens ignited a fierce online feud after Loomer accused Owens of using her Russia trip to prepare for possible asylum if investigated for alleged FARA violations. Loomer also speculated about Owens’ pregnancy. Owens fired back with a deeply personal response, accusing Loomer of lying about her relationship and mocking her Alaskan cruise photos. Their explosive exchange quickly went viral, drawing intense reactions across social media and further escalating tensions between the two controversial conservative personalities.

stories.title: How did ChudTheBuilder’s bond payment end JiDion and Alex Rosen’s partnership? Inside the growing controversy
stories.summary: JiDion has ended his partnership with Alex Rosen after Rosen donated $10,000 toward controversial streamer ChudTheBuilder’s bond. JiDion announced the split in his June 4 video This Is The End, saying the decision went against his values. The fallout has sparked major debate online, with supporters praising JiDion’s move and critics questioning why the split happened now.

stories.title: “They are psychopaths”: Matt Walsh erupts after Jesse Ridgway and Ashley end pregnancy over Down syndrome diagnosis
stories.summary: YouTuber Jesse Ridgway and his wife Ashley revealed that they ended a pregnancy after receiving a Down syndrome diagnosis for their unborn child. The announcement led to heavy criticism from political commentator Matt Walsh, who condemned their decision on X. Ridgway defended the choice, calling the experience traumatic and saying the couple believed it was best for their family.

stories.title: CJP’s NEET stir today, Youth Congress rejects overture
stories.summary: Newly formed online group Cockroach Janta Party sought coordination with the Indian Youth Congress for its upcoming NEET protest, but the overture was rejected. The IYC stated it will not share platforms and is conducting its own nationwide protests, focusing on government accountability. Congress strategists remain skeptical of CJP's sudden emergence.

stories.title: Facing desertion by MPs, Mamata Banerjee clips Abhishek’s wings
FIR filed against ‘Khan Sir’ in coaching centre firing case
Expedite verifications, MEA tells Dhaka
stories.summary: India has urged Bangladesh to expedite the verification of suspected illegal immigrants to facilitate their deportation. The MEA highlighted an existing bilateral mechanism for this process, emphasizing that once nationality is verified, deportation can proceed smoothly. India reiterated that laws are in place to address individuals staying illegally in the country.

stories.title: Oil India strikes natural gas in third Andaman offshore well
stories.summary: State-run Oil India Limited (OIL) has announced the discovery of natural gas in its third exploratory well, Vijayapuram-3, located off the Andaman Islands. This finding further strengthens the hydrocarbon potential of the region, with gas confirmed through continuous flaring and pressure build-up. OIL has now established hydrocarbon presence in two of its three wells in the Andaman offshore block.

stories.title: Great Nicobar Project isn't about defence: Rahul Gandhi
stories.summary: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi released a video of his Nicobar visit, calling the Great Nicobar Project a "lie" and alleging it benefits a businessman for hotels and casinos. He initiated an online petition, "we choose green over greed," urging Indians to protect the island's ecosystem and tribal communities from destruction.

stories.title: No mass data leak: JEE (Advanced) authorities
stories.summary: JEE (Advanced) authorities have clarified that a cloud storage misconfiguration identified by an ethical hacker did not lead to any mass extraction of candidate data. IIT-Roorkee stated the issue, which occurred during technical interventions, was immediately rectified and access was restricted, with no impact on examination records or results.

stories.title: BJP cites GDP figures, says joke’s on Rahul
Blood test can predict lung cancer 5 years before diagnosis
stories.summary: Scientists found blood markers that can predict lung cancer more than five years in advance. This breakthrough could help detect the disease early in India, where most cases are found late. A 14-protein signature in blood identified individuals at higher risk. This finding may lead to earlier monitoring and preventive measures for lung cancer.

stories.title: Bangladesh border guards, BSF accuse each other of push-in attempts
stories.summary: Border Guard Bangladesh accused India's BSF of attempting to push over 70 individuals into Bangladesh near Lalmonirhat, Naogaon, and Chapainawabganj. Meanwhile, BSF reported thwarting a BGB attempt to help 10 Bangladeshis enter India. Both forces disowned stranded individuals, leading to heightened border patrols.

stories.title: SC: Can’t use OSA to deny accused access to documents relied on by prosecution
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that an accused's right to a fair trial includes access to prosecution documents, even if classified under the Official Secrets Act. The court ordered the government to provide highly confidential documents to retired Major General V.K. Singh, facing charges for revealing secrets in his book, emphasizing fair trial rights.

stories.title: Over $580,000 forfeited in Australian visa fraud crackdown; man jailed for submitting false migration documents
Twitch star Nmplol breaks silence on divorce settlement with ex-wife Malena Tudi
stories.summary: Twitch streamer Nmplol has disclosed details of his divorce settlement with ex-wife Malena Tudi. The court finalized their marriage under a no-fault insupportability ruling, with most assets split 50/50, though Malena received a larger share of Starforge Systems. Nmplol also revealed incurring over $400,000 in legal fees and expressed relief that the lengthy process is finally over.

stories.title: Canadian man settles in India with wife's family: Cost of living way lower than Toronto, lost 14lbs in 5 months
PM Modi inspects indigenous defence systems at Surat facility, briefed about desi light tank Zorawar
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Larsen & Toubro's Armed Systems Complex in Surat, reviewing advanced defence equipment and indigenous armoured vehicles. He was briefed on 'Zorawar', India's first indigenous light battle tank designed for mountainous terrains and rapid deployment along the LAC.

stories.title: Nick Polom reaches divorce agreement with Malena Tudi following $400,000 legal battle but one settlement detail grabs attention
stories.summary: Nick Polom, better known as Nmplol, has finalized his no-fault divorce from fellow streamer Malena Tudi. According to Dexerto, most assets were divided equally, while Starforge Systems received separate treatment. The court also denied Tudi’s request for monthly spousal support. The outcome has sparked online debate about alimony, asset division, and the financial cost of public breakups.

stories.title: KSI’s departure from Sidemen triggers fresh debate after group releases clarifying statement
stories.summary: The Sidemen have released a statement following KSI’s departure from the group. While they said they respect his decision, they revealed that the announcement came before a mutual plan had been agreed upon. The group hoped to organize a proper farewell but said events unfolded differently. Despite the change, the remaining members confirmed they will continue creating content together.

stories.title: JiDion rejects Alex Rosen partnership after his $10,000 ChudTheBuilder bond contribution raises questions
stories.summary: YouTuber JiDion has ended his partnership with Alex Rosen after Rosen donated $10,000 toward the bond of Dalton Eatherly, known online as ChudTheBuilder. Speaking to followers, JiDion said the money could have supported more meaningful causes and called the donation unacceptable. The controversy has sparked widespread discussion online and brought renewed attention to both creators.

stories.title: Epstein's prison guard reveals shocking details about day he was found dead in his cell
Cloudburst, flashfloods damaged houses in J&K’s Reasi
stories.summary: Flashfloods from a cloudburst in Reasi's Bathoi village on Thursday caused significant damage to homes and blocked roads with mudslides. Fortunately, no injuries or fatalities were reported. This marks the fifth such event in the Jammu region recently. Authorities are providing immediate assistance to affected families, while adverse weather also led to the suspension of pilgrimages in Kishtwar.

stories.title: Ladakh women’s group slams liquor sale nod, warns of stir
stories.summary: Ladakh's Buddhist women's wing is strongly opposing the Union Territory's new excise policy allowing liquor sales, fearing it will worsen social issues like drug abuse and domestic violence. They advocate for stricter drug control and warn of protests if the policy isn't reconsidered, emphasizing women's role in preserving the region's social fabric.

stories.title: Henry Nowak won't be the last: JD Vance blames mass migration for UK stabbing, triggers diplomatic row
Save Soil–Cauvery Calling: Farmers' income jumps from Rs 30,000 to Rs 3 lakh per acre
stories.summary: A tree-based farming model by Save Soil–Cauvery Calling is transforming agriculture, boosting incomes from Rs 30,000 to Rs 2.5–3 lakh per acre. This ecological solution, accredited by UN bodies, has empowered farmers like Valluvan, enhancing soil health and crop yields. The movement aims to plant 242 crore trees, supporting hundreds of thousands of farmers with extensive training and resources.

stories.title: TMC huddle at Mamata Banerjee's residence: 8 of 80 MLAs turn up amid party split concerns
US judge invalidates travel and visa ban on 39 countries: What happens next?
Indian student fights for life in Chicago after 25-ft fall at subway station, family seeks help
‘Gurdwara is empty’: Sikhs scared to come out of houses after Vickrum Digwa killed Henry Nowak
NTPC to set up flexible coal-fired units to ensure reliable power supply
stories.summary: NTPC is setting up flexible coal-fired thermal power units to balance intermittent renewable energy generation and ensure grid stability. These sub-critical units, designed for two-shift operation and lower minimum loads, will provide crucial balancing support as renewable energy's share grows, reinforcing India's energy transition.

stories.title: Unicorn in the USA: Indians aren't stealing American jobs; they are building entire HR departments
stories.summary: Immigrants are driving America's innovation, founding 59% of billion-dollar startups, known as unicorns. People of Indian origin lead this trend, establishing 96 such companies. These ventures employ thousands and contribute trillions to the U.S. economy, challenging narratives of immigrants harming the job market. International students also play a crucial role in this entrepreneurial surge.

stories.title: YouTubers face backlash for terminating pregnancy after learning child had Down syndrome
New rule for work permit in US: Asylum seekers may lose jobs under DHS proposal
Drug smugglers Baltej Singh and Himatjit Kahlon lose final bid to overturn jail terms in NZ
Henry Nowak case: How handcuffed UK student's murder by Sikh man sparked national outrage - timeline of events
He feared he couldn't compete with AI: Indian family dumps American Dream, leaves US after tragedy
Karmelo Anthony trial: Attorney says he stabbed Austin Metcalf in defense, didn't attack anyone else
World's first AI-designed vaccine developed by UK scientists enters human trials
stories.summary: A groundbreaking AI-designed vaccine for Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever has entered human trials, marking a world-first for medical research. Developed by Oxford University and Basecamp Research, this initiative showcases AI's potential to drastically accelerate vaccine development for emerging infectious diseases. The trial aims to assess safety and immune response, potentially ushering in a new era of AI-assisted medicine.
